# Chimera Launches Securitization Program for HomeXpress-Originated Loans


October 30, 2026 12:00 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://www.chimerareit.com/_assets/_f33cca0544ff7fa7d7efe8fd6a98bd24/chimerareit/news/2026-10-30_Chimera_Launches_Securitization_Program_for_295.pdf)


*Transaction under new conduit advances Chimera’s residential credit strategy and demonstrates the value of its integrated capabilities*


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Chimera Investment Corporation (NYSE: CIM) today announced the closing of its inaugural HomeXpress securitization backed by residential non-qualified mortgage (“NQM”) loans.


The transaction, issued as PRISM 2026-HX1, is the first under Prism, Chimera’s newly-established conduit for residential mortgage loans acquired from its residential mortgage origination subsidiary, HomeXpress Mortgage Corp. (“HomeXpress”), as well as third parties. PRISM 2026-HX1 is collateralized by approximately $291 million of residential mortgage loans originated by HomeXpress. The senior class was rated AAA (sf) by S&P and DBRS.


The transaction brings together Chimera’s residential origination and capital markets capabilities. HomeXpress originated and underwrote the loans; Palisades Advisory Services performed asset-level analytics and diligence in connection with the securitization and, as Asset Manager, will oversee loan performance and servicing following closing; and Chimera structured and completed the transaction.


“The launch of Prism demonstrates the strength of combining HomeXpress’ origination platform and Palisades’ servicing oversight and asset management capabilities with Chimera’s expertise in structured residential credit,” said Phillip J. Kardis II, President and CEO of Chimera. “It also represents an important step in establishing a repeatable channel to recycle capital and grow our platform and earnings over time.”


“This is a key milestone for HomeXpress,” said Kyle Walker, President of HomeXpress. “Our team has built a strong NQM origination platform with consistent underwriting and long-standing partnerships with brokers across the market. With Prism, we now have another capital markets execution channel to support HomeXpress as we continue to grow the business in a disciplined way.”


**About Chimera Investment Corporation** Chimera Investment Corporation (NYSE: CIM) is a diversified, internally managed REIT, that serves the U.S. residential real estate market. Through its Investment Portfolio and Residential Origination segments, the company acquires, manages, finances and originates residential mortgage and real estate-related assets, with the objective of delivering attractive risk-adjusted returns to shareholders.
